name: v8 serialization round trip
source: import { deserialize, serialize } from 'node:v8'; function main(): void { const invalid = new Date(NaN); const value = deserialize(serialize({ valid: new Date(1234), invalid, again: invalid })); console.log(value.valid.getTime(), Number.isNaN(value.invalid.getTime()), value.invalid === value.again); }
